title: Quantifying Language Models' Sensitivity to Spurious Features in Prompt Design or: How I learned to start worrying about prompt formatting
abstract: Several widely used open-source LLMs are extremely sensitive to subtle changes in prompt formatting in few-shot settings, with performance differences of up to 76 accuracy points. Sensitivity remains when increasing model size, few-shot examples, or instruction tuning. Work evaluating LLMs with prompting-based methods should report a range of performance across plausible prompt formats instead of a single format; format performance only weakly correlates between models, questioning the methodological validity of comparing models with an arbitrarily chosen fixed format. Proposes FormatSpread to rapidly evaluate a sampled set of plausible prompt formats and report expected performance intervals.
